A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a device that can measure the critical current for a 5 meter long coated conductor tape in a position and angle-dependent manner.
we can measure the critical current for a long coated conductor as a function of position and angle, and the results can be compared to theoretical calculations and other experiments.

the critical current of YBCO tapes is strongly position dependent.
